title: ast-context-narrowing: AST-Based Structural Narrowing for Diff Context
description: A small library that narrows a code diff to the structural definition it touched -- a method, function, class, or field -- by walking a Tree-sitter AST from the changed byte range upward, instead of using the raw diff hunk or the whole file. Supports C#, TypeScript, TSX, and JavaScript. Includes a regression test suite and a reproducible evaluation harness run against real merged pull requests from a large open-source project.
